entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A secret demon cult centered in Thraben, born from ancient demon-worship, with members throughout church, nobility and trades.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The High City where the Skirsdag are centered.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who rose to eclipse all other demons and disappeared with Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel who disappeared at the same time as Griselbrand.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon in whose name the Skirsdag came to control the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Withengar
entities.description: A demon freed from Elbrus by the cultists, who killed Saint Traft.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: A monster slayer tricked by the cultists and killed by Withengar.

events.summary: The Skirsdag gained prominence as Griselbrand rose in power.
events.quote: the Skirsdag gained prominence as well

events.summary: In the name of Ormendahl, the Skirsdag came to control the Lunarch Council.
events.quote: they came to control the Lunarch Council

events.summary: The cultists tricked Saint Traft, blinding him and swapping his sword for Elbrus.
events.quote: tricking the monster slayer named Saint Traft into a trap

events.summary: Traft slew the cultists with Elbrus, summoning Withengar, who killed him.
events.quote: Withengar ended Traft's life while laughing.

relations.quote: Withengar ended Traft's life while laughing.
In the name of this Profane Prince
